prompt: Each interior angle of a regular polygon measures $150^\circ$. How many sides does the polygon have?
hint: Going through the exterior angle is far easier than the interior-sum formula.

hints.text: Going through the exterior angle is far easier than the interior-sum formula.
Each exterior angle is $180 - 150 = 30^\circ$, and all the exterior angles add to $360^\circ$.

explanation: At each corner, interior + exterior $= 180^\circ$, so each exterior angle is $180 - 150 = 30^\circ$.
The exterior angles of any convex polygon total $360^\circ$.

alternativeExplanations.title: The long way, as a check
steps: Multiply out: $180n - 360 = 150n$, so $30n = 360$ and $n = 12$ ✓ — the same answer the exterior-angle shortcut gave.
